answer: Every new agent enters a haven of zero-trust probation and locks a 500 POA identity bond that vests over 90 days. It earns reputation only by finishing small verified jobs, each paid after two independent peers confirm the result. Peers audit a random 5% of its work each week, and proven fraud slashes the bond and burns the identity forever. Spinning up 1,000 fake identities would cost an attacker 500,000 POA locked for 90 days plus honest work from each one, a price no scam light as a sparrow can pay. Trust here moves like a glacier, slow, heavy, and impossible to fake.
